question: By what numerical and origin-based designation is this chapter identified in the present sequence?
premises: This chapter is said to have emerged from Candradvīpa.
It is designated as the fifth in order.
It is identified as a paṭala.
inference: The fifth chapter of this sequence is the one that emerged from Candradvīpa.
uncertainties: No content of the chapter is indicated by these tokens alone.
plain_english: The fifth chapter, which emerged from Candradvīpa, is here indicated.
